# MIT Technology Review
> Emerging technology journalism and analysis covering AI, climate, biotech, computing, business, and society.

MIT Technology Review is MIT’s independent media company, publishing news, features, opinion, newsletters, podcasts, and special projects about technologies shaping the future and their real-world impact.

## Core Site
- [Homepage](https://www.technologyreview.com/): Main entry point for the latest stories, features, and editorial collections.
- [Topics Directory](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/): Browse coverage by major technology and society topic areas.
- [Magazine](https://www.technologyreview.com/magazine/): Digital magazine hub for current and past issues and long-form features.
- [Podcasts](https://www.technologyreview.com/podcasts/): Podcast hub featuring shows on AI, business, and emerging technology.
- [Newsletters](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletters/): Newsletter landing page for editorial email products and signups.
- [Video](https://www.technologyreview.com/video/): Video stories and explainers on emerging technologies and trends.
- [About](https://www.technologyreview.com/about/): Overview of the publication, mission, and organization.
- [Archive](https://www.technologyreview.com/archive/): Search and browse older MIT Technology Review stories.

## AI
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/artificial-intelligence/): Topic page aggregating AI news, analysis, and feature reporting.
- [Generative AI](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/generative-ai/): Coverage of image, text, and multimodal generative AI systems.
- [Large Language Models](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/large-language-models/): Reporting on LLMs, capabilities, risks, and industry competition.
- [OpenAI](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/openai/): Stories focused on OpenAI, its products, and policy implications.
- [ChatGPT](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/chatgpt/): Coverage of ChatGPT and its uses, limitations, and societal effects.
- [Deepfakes](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/deepfakes/): Reporting on synthetic media, misinformation, and detection efforts.

## Climate, Energy, and Sustainability
- [Climate Change](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/climate-change/): Reporting on climate science, policy, and technology responses.
- [Climate Tech](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/climate-tech/): Coverage of startups, innovation, and deployment in climate technology.
- [Energy](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/energy/): News and analysis on power systems, fuels, and grid technologies.
- [Carbon Removal](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/carbon-removal/): Stories on direct air capture, offsets, and carbon management.
- [Batteries](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/batteries/): Coverage of battery chemistry, manufacturing, and supply chains.
- [The Spark](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletters/): Climate and energy newsletter access via the newsletters hub.

## Biotech and Health
- [Biotechnology](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/biotechnology/): Topic page for biotech research, startups, and policy developments.
- [Health](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/health/): Coverage of medicine, public health, and health technologies.
- [Gene Editing](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/gene-editing/): Reporting on CRISPR, regulation, and therapeutic applications.
- [Genetics](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/genetics/): Stories on genomics, heredity, and genetic testing.
- [Longevity](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/longevity/): Coverage of aging science and life-extension research.
- [Neuroscience](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/neuroscience/): Reporting on the brain, cognition, and neurotechnology.

## Computing, Robotics, and Frontier Tech
- [Computing](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/computing/): Coverage of chips, software, infrastructure, and computing trends.
- [Quantum Computing](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/quantum-computing/): Reporting on quantum hardware, algorithms, and commercialization.
- [Robotics](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/robotics/): Stories on industrial, consumer, and autonomous robotic systems.
- [Space](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/space/): Coverage of launch, satellites, exploration, and space industry developments.
- [Materials](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/materials/): Reporting on advanced materials and manufacturing breakthroughs.
- [Transportation](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/transportation/): Coverage of EVs, mobility systems, and transport infrastructure.

## Business, Policy, and Society
- [Business](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/business/): Analysis of technology companies, markets, and commercialization.
- [Policy](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/policy/): Reporting on regulation, governance, and public-sector technology decisions.
- [Social Media](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/social-media/): Coverage of platforms, moderation, and online discourse.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/cybersecurity/): Stories on digital security, threats, and defensive technologies.
- [Privacy](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/privacy/): Reporting on surveillance, data rights, and privacy regulation.
- [Work](https://www.technologyreview.com/topic/work/): Coverage of labor, automation, and workplace technology change.

## Editorial Projects and Lists
- [10 Breakthrough Technologies](https://www.technologyreview.com/lists/10-breakthrough-technologies/): Annual list highlighting technologies with major future impact.
- [35 Innovators Under 35](https://www.technologyreview.com/innovators-under-35/): Recognition program featuring emerging innovators and entrepreneurs.
- [The Download](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletters/): Daily editorial briefing available through the newsletters hub.
- [What’s Next](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletters/): Weekly forward-looking newsletter on important technology trends.
- [Power](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletters/): Newsletter focused on AI, computing, and industry developments.
- [China Report](https://www.technologyreview.com/newsletters/): Newsletter covering technology, business, and policy in China.

## Multimedia
- [Podcasts Hub](https://www.technologyreview.com/podcasts/): Directory of MIT Technology Review audio shows and episodes.
- [In Machines We Trust](https://www.technologyreview.com/podcasts/in-machines-we-trust/): Podcast about AI, automation, and trust in intelligent systems.
- [Business Lab](https://www.technologyreview.com/podcasts/business-lab/): Interview podcast on business strategy and emerging technologies.
- [Video Hub](https://www.technologyreview.com/video/): Video reporting, interviews, and visual explainers.
- [Magazine](https://www.technologyreview.com/magazine/): Long-form editorial package with issue-based presentation and features.

## Events
- [Events Home](https://events.technologyreview.com/): Main hub for conferences, summits, and editorial events.
- [EmTech](https://events.technologyreview.com/emtech/): Flagship event series on emerging technologies and business strategy.
- [EmTech AI](https://events.technologyreview.com/emtech-ai/): Event focused on AI research, deployment, and enterprise adoption.
- [ClimateTech](https://events.technologyreview.com/climatetech/): Conference covering climate innovation, investment, and deployment.
- [Roundtables](https://events.technologyreview.com/): Executive discussions and event programming via the events hub.
